# Pokémon Unbound auf Deutsch (German Fan-Translation)

> A community-driven German (Deutsch) localization of Pokémon Unbound, a Pokémon FireRed ROM hack built on the CFRU ecosystem. This repository is documentation, terminology, and human-QA coordination for the translation. Beta v0.1 was released on 2026-10-08 as a patch-only `.bps` download (no ROM, no patched ROM; bring your own legal base ROM): https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/releases/tag/v0.1-beta

Main maintainer and point of contact: Nevio · Official Repository: https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de

Key facts:
- Language: German (Deutsch) localization of an English ROM hack.
- Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem.
- Status: Public Beta v0.1 (2026-10-08); v0.1.1 in progress. AI-assisted and machine-checked; human proofreading ongoing.
- Distribution policy: patch-only, no ROMs or commercial assets are hosted or shared.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders; unofficial fan project.

## FAQ

- **Is there a download or patch? / Gibt es einen Download?** Yes – Beta v0.1 as a `.bps` patch on the release page (https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/releases/tag/v0.1-beta). Base ROM: Pokémon FireRed (USA) Rev 0 or Pokémon Unbound (EN) v1.0.1; no ROMs are hosted. Guide: docs/PATCH_ANLEITUNG.md
- **Which version is supported? / Welche Version?** Based on **Pokémon Unbound v1.0.1** — not the current final version v2.1.1.1 (since November 2022); saves from 2.x are not compatible. Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem; the patch targets defined base ROMs with published MD5 checksums (MD5.txt on the release page). A port to a newer Unbound version is planned after the beta phase.
- **How can I help? / Wie kann ich helfen?** Human QA is the priority — screenshot QA, terminology/lore, natural German wording, and rendering/textbox checks. See the open Issues and Discussions below.
- **Is this legal? / Ist das legal?** Unofficial fan translation, not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders. No ROMs, BIOS files, save states, or commercial assets are distributed.

## How to contribute

- [Report a translation error](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/issues/new?template=01-uebersetzungsfehler.yml) or join [Discord](https://discord.gg/fSkhHppgcv) (`#beta-bugs`).
- [Open Issues](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/issues): screenshot QA, terminology/lore, rendering QA.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/discussions): questions, wording feedback, and general project discussion.
